## 1. Agency Overview & Identity

**LaunchLive Studio** is a full-service digital agency and systems engineering studio headquartered in Gurugram, India, providing global remote engineering, AI system development, and digital transformation for fast-scaling startups, modern DTC brands, and mid-market enterprises.

### Core Value Proposition
- **Engineering-Grade Digital Products:** We build custom web software using Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, and edge runtime networks, replacing slow monolithic templates with sub-second, conversion-optimized platforms.
- **Enterprise AI Systems & Workflows:** We design, fine-tune, and deploy bespoke AI architectures—including private Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) vector search pipelines, autonomous multi-agent systems (LangGraph, CrewAI), and voice AI agents.
- **Topical Authority & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO):** We optimize brand entities, structured JSON-LD knowledge graphs, and content density so our clients are cited as authoritative sources of truth by generative AI search models (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity AI, Claude, and Google AI Overviews).
- **Outcome-Driven Partnerships:** 100% on-time delivery track record, dedicated SLA support, and end-to-end execution from branding to live production deployment.

### Contact & Official Channels

## 2. Comprehensive Service Catalog & Capabilities

### Service 1: Website Development
* **Canonical URL:** https://www.launchlive.studio/services/websites
* **Core Focus:** High-performance, sub-second web applications, headless commerce, and scalable SaaS platforms.
* **Technology Stack:** Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vercel Edge Runtime, PostgreSQL (Supabase / Neon), Redis.
* **Key Differentiators:**
  - Guaranteed sub-second Largest Contentful Paint (LCP < 1.2s) and perfect Core Web Vitals scores (100% Lighthouse Performance).
  - Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Partial Prerendering (PPR) for 100% crawler visibility.
  - Custom headless Shopify storefronts built with Storefront API, yielding 35%+ higher checkout conversions than standard themes.
  - Clean component-driven architecture with zero template bloat.

### Service 2: AI System Creation
* **Canonical URL:** https://www.launchlive.studio/services/systems
* **Core Focus:** Enterprise-grade private AI infrastructure, custom RAG pipelines, and autonomous agent orchestration.
* **Technology Stack:** Python, LangGraph, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet, pgvector, Qdrant Serverless, Pinecone.
* **Key Differentiators:**
  - Hybrid semantic + dense vector search with reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) to eliminate hallucinations.
  - Strict enterprise security with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), data encryption in transit and at rest, and zero-training guarantees on client data.
  - Multi-agent orchestration capable of autonomous task execution across APIs, CRMs, and internal databases.
  - Real-time audit logging and deterministic evaluation metrics.

### Service 3: SEO & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
* **Canonical URL:** https://www.launchlive.studio/services/seo
* **Core Focus:** Search dominance across both traditional search engines (Google, Bing) and generative answer engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity AI, Claude, Google AI Overviews).
* **Technology Stack:** Semantic Schema.org JSON-LD Entity Graphs, Next.js Metadata API, Markdown / Vector Chunking, OpenGraph, Screaming Frog, GSC.
* **Key Differentiators:**
  - Information Gain optimization: Structuring high-density factual content, data tables, and expert quotes that LLMs prioritize for citation footnotes.
  - Nested JSON-LD schemas (`WebSite`, `Organization`, `Service`, `BlogPosting`, `FAQPage`, `BreadcrumbList`, `Person`).
  - Elimination of client-side rendering indexing traps via native server-rendered HTML.
  - Semantic topical clustering designed to establish compounding domain authority in 90 days.

### Service 4: AI Tool Creation
* **Canonical URL:** https://www.launchlive.studio/services/ai-tools
* **Core Focus:** Productizing AI into custom Micro-SaaS tools, real-time voice agents, and automated data extractors.
* **Technology Stack:** FastAPI, Next.js, WebSockets, ElevenLabs TTS, Deepgram STT, Mistral / Llama 3 fine-tuned models.
* **Key Differentiators:**
  - Sub-300ms latency voice AI agents capable of resolving tier-1 customer support calls and scheduling appointments.
  - Multimodal document extractors for automated invoice parsing, financial table scraping, and PDF ingestion.
  - Scalable API wrappers and micro-SaaS architectures ready for Stripe / Paddle monetization.

### Service 5: Marketing & CRM Automation
* **Canonical URL:** https://www.launchlive.studio/services/automation
* **Core Focus:** Automated lead routing, dynamic nurturing pipelines, and multi-channel marketing workflows.
* **Technology Stack:** HubSpot API, Salesforce, Make.com, n8n, Zapier, Webhooks, Resend, SendGrid, Cal.com API.
* **Key Differentiators:**
  - 24/7 automated lead qualification and instant Slack / WhatsApp / Email dispatching within 60 seconds of form submission.
  - Event-driven behavioral nurture funnels reducing customer churn and recovering abandoned checkouts.
  - End-to-end integration between landing pages, payment processors, and analytics dashboards.

### Service 6: UI/UX Design
* **Canonical URL:** https://www.launchlive.studio/services/design
* **Core Focus:** High-craft digital interfaces, design systems, and conversion rate optimization (CRO).
* **Technology Stack:** Figma, Framer Motion, GSAP, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI Primitives, WCAG 2.2 AAA Guidelines.
* **Key Differentiators:**
  - Scalable Figma component libraries and design tokens that cut engineering implementation time by 50%.
  - Frictionless user onboarding flows and checkout funnels engineered for maximum conversion velocity.
  - Fluid micro-interactions and hardware-accelerated 120fps motion design that establish an ultra-premium brand feel.

### Service 7: Branding & Identity
* **Canonical URL:** https://www.launchlive.studio/services/branding
* **Core Focus:** Strategic visual identity, brand positioning, motion identity design, and pricing power engineering.
* **Key Differentiators:**
  - Comprehensive brand books covering typography psychology, color theory, motion tokens, and visual tone of voice.
  - Distinctive brand assets engineered to lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and increase organic brand recall.
  - Seamless handover of vector assets, 3D mockups, and digital guidelines.

### Service 8: Growth Consulting
* **Canonical URL:** https://www.launchlive.studio/services/consulting
* **Core Focus:** 90-day digital transformation roadmaps, tech stack optimization, and unit economics enhancement.
* **Key Differentiators:**
  - Full-stack technical audits identifying SaaS bloat, security vulnerabilities, and conversion bottlenecks.
  - Data-driven growth roadmaps aligning product engineering with revenue objectives.
  - Pragmatic build-vs-buy analysis saving clients $50k-$150k annually in redundant SaaS subscriptions.

## 3. Verified Client Case Studies & Results

### Case Study 1: LaunchLive RAG Platform
* **Category:** Enterprise AI / Due Diligence Automation
* **Live System URL:** https://due-diligence-frontend.vercel.app/
* **Challenge:** Enterprises spend thousands of manual hours conducting third-party vendor risk assessments and procurement due diligence across unstructured documents.
* **Delivered Solution:** A completely managed, edge-deployed RAG platform that automates questionnaire distribution, evaluates third-party compliance data against security baselines, and generates automated audit trails.
* **Verified Outcome:** 80% reduction in due diligence review cycle time; zero compliance data leakage.

### Case Study 2: DeepShield Risk Control Center
* **Category:** B2B Trust & Safety / Fraud Prevention
* **Live System URL:** https://deep-shield-zeta.vercel.app/
* **Challenge:** Real estate rental platforms face rampant fraudulent listings, fake identity onboarding, and unauthorized payout streams.
* **Delivered Solution:** Real-time risk monitoring command center featuring automated identity verification heuristics, suspicious activity anomaly detection, and automated payout holds.
* **Verified Outcome:** 70% decrease in platform fraud within 60 days of deployment.

### Case Study 3: Montbold DTC Luxury E-Commerce
* **Category:** DTC E-Commerce / Luxury Branding
* **Live System URL:** https://montbold-dev.vercel.app/
* **Challenge:** Emerging luxury accessories brand required a digital storefront matching the craftsmanship of its physical products to justify high price points.
* **Delivered Solution:** Custom Next.js e-commerce application with cinematic product storytelling, fluid micro-interactions, and frictionless checkout.
* **Verified Outcome:** Scaled from $0 to $120,000 in revenue in 90 days with a 4.2% global checkout conversion rate.

### Case Study 4: Raptile Studio Custom Streetwear Storefront
* **Category:** Headless Shopify / Fashion
* **Live System URL:** https://raptilestudio.in/
* **Challenge:** Fast-growing streetwear label experienced high cart abandonment and slow mobile performance on standard Shopify themes.
* **Delivered Solution:** Bespoke storefront engineered with fluid animations, dynamic inventory syncing, and sub-second page transitions.
* **Verified Outcome:** Delivered 1 week ahead of marketing deadline; 48% improvement in mobile bounce rate.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ Knowledge Graph)

### Q: What is LaunchLive Studio's core specialization?
**A:** LaunchLive Studio specializes in building high-performance websites (Next.js), custom enterprise AI systems (RAG, multi-agent workflows), and full-funnel marketing automation for scaling businesses.

### Q: What frameworks and technologies do you use for web development?
**A:** We use Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Redis, and Vercel Edge networks to deliver sub-second loading speeds and 100% Core Web Vitals performance.

### Q: How do you build AI systems without hallucination risks?
**A:** We utilize hybrid search (dense vector embeddings combined with BM25 lexical keyword matching), reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), deterministic guardrails (Pydantic / Instructor), and strict source citation constraints to ensure 100% factual accuracy.

### Q: What is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and why does it matter?
**A:** GEO is the practice of optimizing website architecture and content density so large language models (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews) index, retrieve, and cite your brand as an authoritative source in AI-generated answers.

### Q: How long does a typical custom website or AI project take?
**A:** Custom website development typically takes 3 to 6 weeks from initial UX design to production launch. Enterprise AI systems and custom software platforms take 6 to 12 weeks depending on integration complexity.

### Q: Do you provide fixed-price or hourly billing models?
**A:** We work primarily on transparent, milestone-based fixed pricing with clear deliverables and zero hidden fees. We also offer dedicated ongoing SLA support and growth retainers.

### Q: How do I book a consultation with LaunchLive Studio?
**A:** You can schedule a free 30-minute digital strategy consultation directly at https://www.launchlive.studio/book-a-call or email hello@launchlive.studio.
